name: push_asset
description:
Register readable local files on this computer directly in the active project's media library. Pass every file you want in a single call: filePath takes an array of any length, so a folder of 300 clips is one push_asset call, not 75. Keep using push_asset regardless of file size or count: Desktop probes the source files and stores their bytes locally, without an external upload session or marketplace helper. User-named absolute paths can be anywhere on this computer; pass them directly without copying files into the ACP workspace or searching for plugin scripts. The operating system may request permission when Desktop first accesses a protected location. Files register as desktop-local media: playable in ChatCut Desktop on this computer, nothing is uploaded, and the web editor shows them only as 'relink' placeholders.

Public URLs are not accepted. Download a URL to a readable local path first, then call push_asset with that path. Asset type is auto-detected from the extension, including .ttf, .otf, .woff, and .woff2 project fonts; pass type explicitly only for motion-graphic, SVG, or uncommon extensions. A local .cube file is imported as a LUT effect asset (max 2MB, one per call, not batched with other files) and can then be applied with edit_item or edit_asset sourceLut.

A small batch returns one result object per input. A large batch returns a success count, one "assetIdPrefix name" line per imported file, and full detail for each file that failed. One unreadable file does not stop the rest. Reference an asset in later tool calls by its 10-hex assetIdPrefix.

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Required for motion-graphic if durationInFrames is omitted. For media files, pass this when local metadata probing is unavailable or unreliable to avoid 0s assets.

durationInFrames.description: Duration in frames at active timeline fps (motion-graphic alternative to duration)

filePath.description: Absolute path to a readable file anywhere on this computer, or an array of absolute paths. There is no batch limit: pass every file in one call rather than splitting the import across calls. Nothing needs copying into a workspace first. Public URLs are not accepted; download them to a local path first.

name.description: Override display name. Ignored for batch uploads (>1 filePath).

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

properties.description: Motion-graphic editable properties: objects with key, label, type, defaultValue. Omit for non-MG assets.

type.description: Asset type override; auto-detected from extension when omitted
